column1: Four settings on added-defect inputs. Direct LLM uses a different prompt.
column2: 注入缺陷输入上的四种设置。直接调用模型使用不同提示。

column1: F1 change from each filter check, in percentage points. Each input group has 60 documents and three prompts. Positive values favour the full filter.
column2: 各项过滤检查带来的 F1 变化，单位为百分点。每组输入有 60 篇文档和三种提示。正值表示完整过滤器更好。

column1: V2 selector with the default absolute prior score. Accepted counts are actions or bundles, shown as added-defect / model-built. Each F1 uses 225 documents.
column2: 默认绝对先验评分下的 v2 选择器。接受数统计动作或编辑包，按注入缺陷／模型构建输入排列。每项 F1 使用 225 篇文档。

column1: V2 selector on saved proposals. Relative scores use equal weights as the zero point. Accepted counts are added-defect / model-built.
column2: 保存建议上的 v2 选择器。相对评分以等权重为零点。接受数按注入缺陷／模型构建输入排列。

column1: First SROIE test on 60 receipts. Exact match uses labelled fields. Normalized F1 ignores case and whitespace in values.
column2: 首次 SROIE 测试，共 60 张收据。精确匹配使用有标签字段。规范化 F1 忽略取值中的大小写和空白。

column1: First receipt scores. Points show mean F1 and 95\% document-bootstrap CIs. Each raw/gated pair uses one response. The dashed line shows input F1.
column2: 首次收据评分。点表示平均 F1，误差线为 95\% 文档 bootstrap 置信区间。每个原始／过滤对照使用一个响应。虚线表示输入 F1。

column1: Extra scores after collection on sixty receipts. Fence-compatible removes outer Markdown fences. ID-normalized also assigns the known document ID before filtering. Both use the saved responses.
column2: 60 张收据在采集后的补充评分。围栏兼容处理去掉外层 Markdown 围栏。编号规范化还在过滤前分配已知文档编号。两者均使用保存的响应。

column1: Earlier selector results on 225 inputs per group. The oracle uses references to find the best saved subset. One document can have several trials.
column2: 早期选择器结果，每组 225 个输入。oracle 利用参考答案寻找最佳保存子集。一篇文档可以有多次试改。

column1: Time and memory for reports on separate document batches. Local updates check one changed document. Memory measures new batch storage with shared source text.
column2: 独立文档批次的报告时间和内存。局部更新只检查一篇修改后的文档。内存统计共享源文本时新增的批次存储。

column1: Request costs. Mean times include retries and pacing. Source setup and queue time are counted apart.
column2: 请求成本。平均时间包含重试和请求间隔等待。来源设置与排队时间另计。

column1: Time and memory for graph reports. Memory counts peak new batch storage in MiB. Source texts are shared.
column2: 图报告的时间和内存。内存统计新增批次存储峰值，单位为 MiB，源文本共享。

column1: Test data with added defects. The last three columns count documents.
column2: 注入缺陷测试数据。最后三列为文档数。

column1: Repair on 225 test documents with 450 added defects. Lower over-repair, call count, and request time are better.
column2: 225 篇测试文档、450 个注入缺陷上的修复结果。过度修复、调用数和请求时间越低越好。

column1: Repair of added defects. \textbf{a}, Repair rate, triple F1, and exact match with 95\% CIs from document sampling. \textbf{b}, Scores and request times for methods using one or two calls.
column2: 注入缺陷修复。\textbf{a}：修复率、三元组 F1 和整图匹配，带基于文档抽样的 95\% 置信区间。\textbf{b}：一次或两次调用方法的分数与请求时间。

column1: Repair of model-built graphs. Difference reduction uses the 77 inputs that differ from the reference. Other scores use all 225 documents.
column2: 模型构建图的修复。差异减少率使用 77 个与参考不同的输入，其余分数使用全部 225 篇文档。

column1: Repair scores by input type. The valid-JSON group shows repair of parsed graphs. The invalid-JSON group shows recovery from empty inputs.
column2: 按输入类型划分的修复分数。有效 JSON 组展示可解析图的修复，无效 JSON 组展示空输入的恢复。

column1: Gemma prompt tests on 60 documents per input group. Each raw/gated pair uses the same response.
column2: Gemma 提示测试，每组输入 60 篇文档。每个原始／过滤对照使用同一响应。

column1: Prompt, filter, and selector tests. Panels a--b use Gemma outputs on 60 documents. Each raw/gated pair uses the same response. Bars show 95\% document-bootstrap CIs. Panel c uses saved Claude proposals for 225 documents.
column2: 提示、过滤和选择器测试。a--b 使用 60 篇文档的 Gemma 输出；每个原始／过滤对照使用同一响应，误差线表示 95\% 文档 bootstrap 置信区间。c 使用 225 篇文档保存的 Claude 建议。

column1: Mean F1 changes in percentage points. Each input group has 60 paired documents. Each effect averages over the other two switches. CIs are 95\% document-bootstrap intervals. $p_H$ corrects the six main-effect tests with Holm correction.
column2: 平均 F1 变化，单位为百分点。每组输入有 60 篇配对文档，各效应对另外两个开关取平均。区间为 95\% 文档 bootstrap 置信区间。$p_H$ 对六项主效应检验进行 Holm 校正。

column1: Two-model results on the same 60 added-defect inputs.
column2: 两个模型在相同 60 个注入缺陷输入上的结果。

column1: Repair on 60 new receipts. Methods share field meanings, source lines, and the same whitespace check. Exact match uses the labelled fields.
column2: 60 张新收据的修复。各方法共享字段含义、来源行和空白检查。精确匹配使用有标签字段。

column1: New receipt test. Left: mean F1 with 95\% document-bootstrap CIs. Right: paired F1 changes. All methods share field meanings and source lines.
column2: 新收据测试。左：平均 F1 及 95\% 文档 bootstrap 置信区间。右：配对 F1 变化。所有方法共享字段含义和来源行。

column1: Source-line tests on 60 receipts. Each row uses the same model, source, output limit, and filter. Random hints have about the same character length as the index.
column2: 60 张收据上的来源行测试。各行使用相同模型、原文、输出上限和过滤器。随机提示与索引的字符长度大致相同。

column1: Component and source-line tests. Points show mean paired F1 changes. Bars show 95\% CIs for each change. The component and receipt tests use separate Holm groups.
column2: 组件与来源行测试。点表示平均配对 F1 变化，误差线为各项变化的 95\% 置信区间。组件测试与收据测试分别进行 Holm 校正。

column1: Contract results on 56 documents. F1 checks exact text after whitespace cleanup. Lost counts correct input facts removed. The input row gives the initial graph cost; repair rows give the repair-call cost.
column2: 56 份文档的合同结果。F1 检查空白清理后的精确文本。“丢失”统计被删除的正确输入事实。输入行给出初始图成本，修复行给出修复调用成本。

column1: Contract scores. Points show mean document F1. Bars show 95\% CIs for each method. The text gives the paired repair--extraction CI.
column2: 合同分数。点表示文档平均 F1，误差线为各方法的 95\% 置信区间。正文给出修复与抽取的配对差值区间。

column1: Human scores. Agreement and $\kappa$ use the two original 0/1/U answers. Positive counts use final labels. Acceptance rates use the cases with a 0 or 1 answer.
column2: 人工评分。一致率和 $\kappa$ 使用两位评审原始的 0/1/U 答案。正例数使用最终标签，接受率使用答案为 0 或 1 的项目。

column1: Actual-edit acceptance by setting. The random sample has different group sizes. Rates use edits with a clear decision.
column2: 按设置划分的实际编辑接受率。随机样本的各组大小不同，比例使用有明确判断的编辑。

column1: Research questions and test results.
column2: 研究问题与测试结果。

column1: Three scopes of graph checks. Local checks find repeated facts and unlinked nodes. Graph checks test document IDs and field names. Source checks look for values in the text. Both repair paths use these groups to build an assessment profile.
column2: 图检查的三个范围。局部检查查找重复事实和无连接节点，图检查测试文档编号和字段名，来源检查在文本中查找值。两条修复路径都用这些检查构建评估概况。

column1: Scale-aware routing for edit selection. The assessment profile and graph counts feed the router. It gives a repair score and weights for three edit scopes. The selector tries model and rule edits on graph copies, applies the best allowed positive-score edit, and checks again.
column2: 用于编辑选择的尺度感知路由。评估概况和图统计量输入路由器，得到修复分数和三个编辑范围的权重。选择器在图副本上尝试模型与规则编辑，执行最佳允许正分编辑，再次检查。

column1: One round of trial checking. The router weighs edit scopes. The selector scores each model or rule edit on a graph copy, checks the bounds, and applies the best allowed positive-score edit. It then rebuilds the assessment profile. The saved-proposal test allows twelve rounds.
column2: 一轮试改检查。路由器为编辑范围赋权，选择器在图副本上为每项模型或规则编辑打分、检查边界，并执行最佳允许正分编辑。随后重新构建评估概况。保存建议测试最多允许十二轮。
